create_scannet_split: create train and validation split JSON files for ScanNet dataset by scene type
run_scannet_split: run scannet_split.py to generate train_split.json and validation_split.json from ScanNet scans
build_scannet_dataset: build a ScansDataset instance from a ScanNet scan directory with a cache path
test_scannet_split: test the scannet_split script produces non-overlapping train and validation split files
summarize_scannet_split: summarize how scannet_split.py divides ScanNet scans into train and validation sets by scene type
